name: Frame-accurate multi-track timeline
notes: Integer frame model; reworked web timeline uses real project state, selection, snapping, markers and track flags. Native adapter remains a gate.

name: Trim, split, ripple, roll, slip, slide
notes: Pure operations with unit coverage and web inspector commands for trim, split, ripple, roll, slip, slide and move.

name: Manual mask tools and morphology
notes: Canvas brush/lasso/magic path writes a real Gray mask; morphology/refinement and visible mask display are connected.

name: This frame / range / all frames
notes: Data model and inspector control present.

name: Mask tracking with measured confidence
notes: Decoded local video provider is connected to the hybrid reference tracker; worker/native production scheduling remains a gate.

name: SAM2 mask-tracking option
notes: Explicit sparse SAM2 load path; async decoded provider bridge and honest indeterminate model load. Exact pinned weights/benchmark remain a release gate.

name: Omniframe track-transform-repair-composite
notes: Real decoded local video provider and non-destructive operation record are connected; full colour render graph/export hookup remains a gate.

name: Point/object/camera/non-rigid tracking layers
notes: Sparse hybrid point/mask path; full planar/3D solve is a future gate.

name: Data-driven effects and transitions
notes: CPU reference effects are now applied to viewer and WebCodecs export; GPU shader parity remains a production verification gate.

name: 3D scene, materials, lights, cameras, environment
notes: Three.js GLB/glTF viewport with orbit controls, room/PMREM lighting and parser error state is connected; serialized scene authoring remains a gate.

name: FABRIK/CCD IK, skinning and clip sampling
notes: Engine data path complete; viewport animation/rig/IK controls remain a gate.

name: Real CPU lightmap/AO reference bake
notes: Real CPU bake can be started from the 3D inspector and reports measured bake time/cache key; native/GPU scheduling remains a gate.

name: Typed validated template slots
notes: Rejects incompatible 3D/image content unless fallback declared.

name: Versioned .vxproj format, migrations, recovery metadata
notes: Browser autosave/recovery uses serialized .vxproj snapshots; Tauri atomic write commands are present but uncompiled here.

name: Landing + responsive editor workbench
notes: Reworked local-media canvas viewer, responsive timeline/inspector, actual browser export adapter, 3D viewport and honest empty/error states.

name: Tauri 2 desktop shell
notes: Tauri 2 shell plus native command boundary for atomic save, recovery, fingerprints, capability probe and cancellation; toolchain build not run here.

name: Native FFmpeg orchestration
notes: Desktop capability probe and audited command boundary exist; fixed FFmpeg orchestration/build remains unverified because FFmpeg is absent.

name: WebCodecs MP4 export
notes: WebCodecs H.264 + AAC encoder and MIT mp4-muxer are wired; the adapter refuses unsupported encoders and undecodable audio rather than emitting a silent track. Runtime support and output fixture validation remain capability/CI gates.
